items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I remember being down at the Village Vanguard and thinking, that was me, I mean knew me, John Coltrane, and I was to him about reeds backstage and he was trying different reeds

ctx.x: Did you ever get with your brother and say hey, check out this bop, come on, get with it.

I think I mentioned some things like that. I think he was more, you know you get stuck in your ways a little bit. So I think he liked it but I think it was more like the swing’s the thing. If it don’t swing, you know, with the recognizable thing, the other thing was a little far out, just like certain things are far out for me. I mean I’m interested like these “Stellar Explorations,” John Coltrane you know. But I mean it’s interesting but I don’t know if I’d want to go there, or could go there.
Yeah. That’s a ways out there.
